answer: Run a synchronized atlas relay from the jetty: identities join crews of twelve and a signed baton must circle the crew, each member checking the last signature and re-signing within three seconds, the loop closing in under thirty-six seconds from one global tick. The atlas lists every crew route, the jetty timestamps each handoff, and a crew with a missed slot is parked in the haven for re-verification instead of earning. Faking 1,000 puppets means staffing 1,000 three-second slots at once: 1,000 x $0.50 = $500 per round, no bulk discount, while an honest identity pays $0.50 once.
